required_documents.name: Project Narrative
required_documents.details: Detailed description of community need, proposed housing/infrastructure development, and capacity of applicant.

required_documents.name: HUD-424-CB Detailed Budget Form and Justification
required_documents.details: Comprehensive cost breakdown by activity line item and funding source.

required_documents.name: Community Consultation and Partner Agreements
required_documents.details: Documentation of community engagement and partner commitment letters.

required_documents.name: SAM.gov UEI Registration
required_documents.details: Active SAM.gov registration with Unique Entity Identifier.

eligibility.summary: Individuals, foreign entities, and sole proprietorship organizations are not eligible to compete for, or receive, awards made under this announcement. In North Carolina, eligible entities fitting the organizational requirements may apply.

cost_share.details: No cost sharing or non-federal matching funds are required.

review_criteria.criterion: Work Plan Feasibility and Milestone Schedule

submission_limits: Applicant organizations may submit more than one proposal, provided each proposal is scientifically distinct.
important_notes: Forecasted Opportunity: This is an advance forecast notice. Official application packages and final closing dates will be released upon posting.
Application submission is administered via Grants.gov or the designated federal portal for opportunity PIH-2600-DC-0084.
SAM.gov registration must be active with valid Unique Entity Identifier (UEI) prior to submission; allow 3-4 weeks for new registrations.
Review all instructions, eligibility requirements, and deadlines published on Grants.gov before preparing submission.
